course.title: Kizashi Path · N5 → N4
course.description: A practical path through beginner Japanese, organized as Kizashi journeys but backed by the union of Genki I/II, Minna no Nihongo I/II, and the independent Kizashi audit.

chapters.title: First encounters
chapters.description: Meet people, orient yourself in time, and handle your first small transactions.

lessons.title: Meeting people
lessons.subtitle: はじめまして
lessons.description: Introduce yourself, ask simple identity questions, and recognize the language around names, study, work, and family.

lessons.title: Time and schedules
lessons.subtitle: 今、何時ですか
lessons.description: Tell time, understand a simple schedule, and say when everyday actions happen.

lessons.title: Shopping and money
lessons.subtitle: これ、お願いします
lessons.description: Identify things, ask prices, use basic counters, and complete a small purchase.

chapters.title: Living your day
chapters.description: Build routines, eat, describe the world, and talk about people close to you.

lessons.title: Food and routines
lessons.subtitle: 毎日のこと
lessons.description: Talk about ordinary meals and the actions that make up a day.

lessons.title: Home and places
lessons.subtitle: 部屋はどこですか
lessons.description: Describe where people and things are and what belongs to whom.

lessons.title: Family and describing people
lessons.subtitle: 家族のこと
lessons.description: Talk about family, appearance, preferences, and simple qualities without treating description as a separate grammar list.

lessons.title: Weather and seasons
lessons.subtitle: 今日はどんな天気？
lessons.description: Describe weather and seasons, then connect them to plans and impressions.

chapters.title: Around town
chapters.description: Move through town, ask for help, eat out, and make plans with other people.

lessons.title: Transport and directions
lessons.subtitle: 駅までお願いします
lessons.description: Buy a ticket, board and leave transport, and follow straightforward directions.

lessons.title: Food and restaurants
lessons.subtitle: 注文をお願いします
lessons.description: Order food, understand a small menu-like exchange, and make polite requests in context.

lessons.title: Invitations and plans
lessons.subtitle: いっしょに行きませんか
lessons.description: Invite someone, accept or soften a refusal, and say what you want to do next.

chapters.title: Choices and explanations
chapters.description: Ask for things, explain problems, compare options, and speak more naturally about experience.

lessons.title: Requests, permission, and rules
lessons.subtitle: してもいいですか
lessons.description: Make requests, give permission, prohibit actions, and express simple obligations.

lessons.title: Health and school
lessons.subtitle: 学校と体
lessons.description: Explain a simple problem, ask questions, and understand basic health advice.

lessons.title: Experience and comparison
lessons.subtitle: 行ったことがあります
lessons.description: Compare choices, talk about things you have done, and describe a sequence of representative activities.

lessons.title: Casual speech and opinions
lessons.subtitle: どう思う？
lessons.description: Move between polite and plain forms, quote thoughts, and handle ordinary opinion exchanges.

chapters.title: Acting with more range
chapters.description: Enter N4 through ability, plans, favors, conditions, and changing states.

lessons.title: Ability and possibility
lessons.subtitle: できること
lessons.description: Say what you can do and distinguish potential meaning from neighboring forms.

lessons.title: Plans, preparation, and trying
lessons.subtitle: 予定と準備
lessons.description: Decide, prepare, try, and talk about what you intend to do.

lessons.title: Giving, receiving, and favors
lessons.subtitle: してくれたこと
lessons.description: Track viewpoint when gifts and helpful actions move between people.

lessons.title: Conditions and consequences
lessons.subtitle: もし〜なら
lessons.description: Compare と、たら、ば、and なら by the kinds of conditions and advice they naturally carry.

chapters.title: Evidence and connection
chapters.description: Connect clauses, report information, and distinguish what you saw, heard, inferred, or merely consider possible.

lessons.title: Change, habits, and decisions
lessons.subtitle: 変わること、続けること
lessons.description: Separate changes that happen from habits and decisions you deliberately maintain.

lessons.title: Appearance, reports, and inference
lessons.subtitle: そう・よう・らしい
lessons.description: Keep visible appearance, hearsay, resemblance, expectation, and possibility apart.

lessons.title: Quoting thoughts and reports
lessons.subtitle: 思ったこと、聞いたこと
lessons.description: Use quotation to report speech, thoughts, questions, and names without flattening them into one pattern.

lessons.title: Contrast and connected thought
lessons.subtitle: でも、それでも
lessons.description: Link reasons, contrasts, concessions, and additional points across longer statements.

lessons.title: Time, phase, and continuity
lessons.subtitle: しているところ
lessons.description: Place actions inside a time window and distinguish what is beginning, ongoing, completed, or freshly finished.

chapters.title: Who acts, what changes
chapters.description: Work with transitivity, passive and causative viewpoints, purpose, and procedural language.

lessons.title: States and actions
lessons.subtitle: 自動詞と他動詞
lessons.description: Contrast what changes on its own with what someone deliberately changes.

lessons.title: Passive situations
lessons.subtitle: 受身の場面
lessons.description: Describe events from the viewpoint of the person or thing affected.

lessons.title: Causing and allowing
lessons.subtitle: させる場面
lessons.description: Express making and allowing someone to act, with clear roles for the causer and the person acting.

lessons.title: Purpose, method, and procedure
lessons.subtitle: 何のために、どうやって
lessons.description: Explain why something is done, how to do it, and what order instructions should follow.

lessons.title: Ease, difficulty, and choosing a service
lessons.subtitle: 使いやすいですか
lessons.description: Describe practical ease and difficulty while making choices in service situations.

chapters.title: Formal interaction
chapters.description: Finish the path with instructions, respectful and humble language, and causative-passive perspective.

lessons.title: Instructions and relaying messages
lessons.subtitle: 伝えてください
lessons.description: Understand direct instructions and pass a message on without losing who said what.

lessons.title: Respectful and humble Japanese
lessons.subtitle: 丁寧に話す
lessons.description: Choose respectful or humble language according to whose action is being elevated or lowered.

lessons.title: Pressure, obligation, and resolution
lessons.subtitle: させられた経験
lessons.description: Recognize causative-passive situations and close the path by talking about imposed actions and deliberate resolutions.
